stemMd: A positive integer n is divisible by 6 but not by 4. Which statement must be true?

options.label: C
options.textMd: n leaves remainder 1 when divided by 2.

explanationMd: Divisibility by 6 makes n even. If n/2 were even, n would be divisible by 4, contrary to the condition. Hence n/2 must be odd.

distractorRationale.a: Divisibility by 12 would imply divisibility by 4.
distractorRationale.b: Since n is divisible by 6, n/3 is even.
distractorRationale.c: It is even because it is divisible by 6.
distractorRationale.e: A positive multiple of 6 is composite.
